```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(fpp3)
library(tsibbledata)
library(datasets)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)

```

# Exercise 1. Additive Decomposition: Beer Production Data

- Load the dataset `aus_production` from the package `tsibbledata`, read the dataset's description and extract quarterly beer production from 1992 Q1 to 2000 Q4.

```{r ex1-load}
beer <- aus_production |>
  filter_index("1992 Q1" ~ "2000 Q4") |>
  select(Beer)

```

- Plot the time series.

```{r ex1-plot}
autoplot(beer, ts.colour = "blue")
```

- Perform a manual decomposition using LOESS for trend and average detrended values per quarter for seasonality.

```{r ex1-manual}

# 1. Trend: LOESS on a time index
beer <- beer |>
  mutate(t = row_number())

loess_fit <- loess(Beer ~ t, data = beer, span = 0.5)

beer <- beer |>
  mutate(
    trend     = fitted(loess_fit),
    detrended = Beer - trend,
    qtr       = quarter(Quarter)
  )

# 2. Seasonality: average detrended value per quarter
seasonal_means <- beer |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(qtr) |>
  summarise(seasonal = mean(detrended)) |>
  mutate(seasonal = seasonal - mean(seasonal))   # centre so the effects sum to 0

# 3. Put it back together and compute the remainder
beer_manual <- beer |>
  left_join(seasonal_means, by = "qtr") |>
  mutate(remainder = Beer - trend - seasonal)


beer_manual |>
  select(Quarter, Beer, trend, seasonal, remainder) |>
  pivot_longer(-Quarter, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                            levels = c("Beer", "trend", "seasonal", "remainder"))) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

- Perform an STL decomposition using `STL()` from the `fpp3` package.

```{r ex1-stl}
beer_stl <- beer |>
  model(STL(Beer))

beer_stl |> components()             # table with trend, season_year, remainder, season_adjust
beer_stl |> components() |> autoplot()

```

# Exercise 2. Synthetic Additive Time Series

- Generate a quarterly additive series with linear trend, seasonal component, and Gaussian noise:

$$Y_t = T_t + S_t + \varepsilon_t$$

```{r ex2-generate}
n = 100
t <- 1:n

trend <- 30 + 0.8 * t
seasonal <- rep(c(10, -5, -15, 10), length.out = n) # sums tp 0 over a year
noise    <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 3)

y <- trend + seasonal + noise

synth_add <- tsibble(
  Quarter  = yearquarter("2000 Q1") + 0:(n - 1),
  y        = y,
  trend    = trend,
  seasonal = seasonal,
  noise    = noise,
  index    = Quarter
)

```

- Plot the generated series.

```{r ex2-plot}
synth_add |> autoplot(y)
```

- Perform a manual decomposition using LOESS for the trend and average detrended values per quarter for seasonality.

```{r ex2-manual}
loess_fit <- loess(y ~ t, data = synth_add, span = 0.5)

```

- Perform STL decomposition.

```{r ex2-stl}
# 1. Trend: LOESS on a time index
synth_work <- synth_add |>
  mutate(t = row_number())

loess_fit <- loess(y ~ t, data = synth_work, span = 0.5)

synth_work <- synth_work |>
  mutate(
    trend_manual = fitted(loess_fit),
    detrended    = y - trend_manual,
    qtr          = quarter(Quarter)
  )

# 2. Seasonality: average detrended value per quarter
seasonal_means <- synth_work |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(qtr) |>
  summarise(seasonal_manual = mean(detrended)) |>
  mutate(seasonal_manual = seasonal_manual - mean(seasonal_manual))

# 3. Put it back together and compute the remainder
synth_manual <- synth_work |>
  left_join(seasonal_means, by = "qtr") |>
  mutate(remainder_manual = y - trend_manual - seasonal_manual)


#plot it to look nice
synth_manual |>
  select(Quarter, y, trend_manual, seasonal_manual, remainder_manual) |>
  pivot_longer(-Quarter, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                            levels = c("y", "trend_manual",
                                       "seasonal_manual", "remainder_manual"))) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

- Compare the true value of the trend, seasonal and error components with their estimated values using a manually implemented STL decomposition and the implemented STL method.

```{r ex2-compare}
# 1. STL estimates
stl_comp <- synth_add |>
  model(STL(y ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Quarter,
         trend_stl     = trend,
         seasonal_stl  = season_year,
         remainder_stl = remainder)

# 2. Truth + manual + STL in one table
comparison <- synth_manual |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Quarter,
         trend_true     = trend,
         seasonal_true  = seasonal,
         remainder_true = noise,
         trend_manual, seasonal_manual, remainder_manual) |>
  left_join(stl_comp, by = "Quarter")

# 3. Long format: one row per quarter × component × method
comparison_long <- comparison |>
  pivot_longer(-Quarter,
               names_to  = c("component", "method"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("trend", "seasonal", "remainder")))


comparison_long |>
  as_tsibble(index = Quarter, key = c(component, method)) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y")


truth <- comparison_long |>
  filter(method == "true") |>
  select(Quarter, component, true_value = value)

comparison_long |>
  filter(method != "true") |>
  left_join(truth, by = c("Quarter", "component")) |>
  group_by(component, method) |>
  summarise(RMSE = sqrt(mean((value - true_value)^2)), .groups = "drop")

```

# Exercise 3. Multiplicative Decomposition: AirPassengers

- Use the dataset `AirPassengers` from the package `datasets`. Plot the series.

```{r ex3-plot}
head(AirPassengers)
```

- Transform the series using logarithm to perform a multiplicative decomposition.

```{r ex3-log}
air <- AirPassengers |>
  as_tsibble() |>
  mutate(log_value = log(value),
         t = row_number())

head(air)
```

- Perform a manual decomposition (LOESS for trend, average detrended by month for seasonality) and STL decomposition.

```{r ex3-manual-stl}
#find trend using LOESS
loess_fit <- loess(log_value ~ t, data = air, span = 0.5)

#remutate data with detrended
air <- air |>
  mutate(
    trend = fitted(loess_fit),
    detrended = log_value - trend,
    mth = month(index)
  )

#find seasonal mean (by month)
seasonal_means <- air |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(mth) |>
  summarise(seasonal = mean(detrended)) |>
  mutate(seasonal = seasonal - mean(seasonal))

# put it all together
air_manual <- air |>
  left_join(seasonal_means, by = 'mth') |>
  mutate(remainder = log_value - trend - seasonal)

#plot
air_manual |>
  select(index, log_value, trend, seasonal, remainder) |>
  pivot_longer(-index, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                            levels = c("log_value", "trend", "seasonal", "remainder"))) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  

```

- Plot and compare the trend, seasonal, and remainder components from the manual and STL decompositions on log-scale.

```{r ex3-compare}

# 1. STL on the log series
air_stl <- air |>
  model(STL(log_value ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(index,
         trend_stl     = trend,
         seasonal_stl  = season_year,
         remainder_stl = remainder)

# 2. Manual + STL in one table
air_compare <- air_manual |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(index,
         trend_manual     = trend,
         seasonal_manual  = seasonal,
         remainder_manual = remainder) |>
  left_join(air_stl, by = "index")

# 3. Long format: one row per month × component × method
air_compare_long <- air_compare |>
  pivot_longer(-index,
               names_to  = c("component", "method"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("trend", "seasonal", "remainder")))

# 4. Plot
air_compare_long |>
  as_tsibble(index = index, key = c(component, method)) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "log scale", title = "AirPassengers: manual vs STL decomposition")

```

# Exercise 4. Synthetic Multiplicative Time Series

- Generate a synthetic monthly multiplicative series:

$$Y_t = T_t \times S_t \times \varepsilon_t$$

with increasing trend, multiplicative seasonal pattern, and multiplicative noise.

```{r ex4-generate}
set.seed(123)

n <- 36
t <- 1:n

trend    <- 12 + 0.43 * t
seasonal <- rep(c(0.90, 0.88, 0.95, 1.00, 1.05, 1.15,
                  1.25, 1.22, 1.05, 0.95, 0.85, 0.75), length.out = n)
noise    <- exp(rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.05))   # factors around 1, about ±5%

y <- trend * seasonal * noise

synth_mult <- tsibble(
  Month    = yearmonth("2000 Jan") + 0:(n - 1),
  y        = y,
  trend    = trend,
  seasonal = seasonal,
  noise    = noise,
  index    = Month
)


```

- Plot the series.

```{r ex4-plot}
synth_mult |> autoplot(y)
```

- Transform using logarithm and perform manual decomposition (trend via LOESS, seasonal via average detrended per month) and STL decomposition.

```{r ex4-manual-stl}
synth_dec <- synth_mult |>
  mutate(y_log = log(y),
         t     = row_number())

# trend
model_loess <- loess(y_log ~ t, data = synth_dec, span = 0.9) #played around with the span cause it looked very wroong at first with 0.5

# organise
synth_dec <- synth_dec |>
  mutate(
    trend_manual = fitted(model_loess),
    detrended    = y_log - trend_manual,
    mth          = month(Month)
  )

# seasonal
seasonal_mean <- synth_dec |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(mth) |>
  summarise(seasonal_manual = mean(detrended)) |>
  mutate(seasonal_manual = seasonal_manual - mean(seasonal_manual))

# join + add error term
synth_dec <- synth_dec |>
  left_join(seasonal_mean, by = "mth") |>
  mutate(remainder_manual = y_log - trend_manual - seasonal_manual)

# plot
synth_dec |>
  select(Month, y_log, trend_manual, seasonal_manual, remainder_manual) |>
  pivot_longer(-Month, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                            levels = c("y_log", "trend_manual",
                                       "seasonal_manual", "remainder_manual"))) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = "log scale", title = "Manual decomposition (log scale)")


# STL estimates
synth_stl <- synth_dec |>
  model(STL(y_log ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Month,
         trend_stl     = trend,
         seasonal_stl  = season_year,
         remainder_stl = remainder)




```

- Compare the true value of the trend, seasonal and error components with their estimated values using a manually implemented STL decomposition and the implemented STL method. (all on log-scale).

```{r ex4-compare}
# True (log scale) + manual + STL
synth_compare <- synth_dec |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(trend_true     = log(trend),
         seasonal_true  = log(seasonal),
         remainder_true = log(noise)) |>
  select(Month,
         trend_true, seasonal_true, remainder_true,
         trend_manual, seasonal_manual, remainder_manual) |>
  left_join(synth_stl, by = "Month")

# Long format
synth_compare_long <- synth_compare |>
  pivot_longer(-Month,
               names_to  = c("component", "method"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("trend", "seasonal", "remainder")))

# Plot
synth_compare_long |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month, key = c(component, method)) |>
  autoplot(value) +
  facet_grid(component ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "log scale", title = "True vs manual vs STL decomposition (log scale)")

# RMSE vs truth
truth <- synth_compare_long |>
  filter(method == "true") |>
  select(Month, component, true_value = value)

synth_compare_long |>
  filter(method != "true") |>
  left_join(truth, by = c("Month", "component")) |>
  group_by(component, method) |>
  summarise(RMSE = sqrt(mean((value - true_value)^2)), .groups = "drop")
```
